key.answer_key: No. Unreinforced AZ91 itself carries a threshold stress of about 24 MPa (the 80 MPa applied condition plots at an effective stress of about 56 MPa), close to the composites' threshold-stress range of about 24-35 MPa, so the panels do not confine this behavior to the SiC-reinforced samples (o16).
